headline: Keppel CEO Loh Chin Hua Defends Proposed StarHub and M1 Merger
seoTitle: Keppel CEO Discusses StarHub and M1 Merger
metaDescription: Keppel CEO Loh Chin Hua stated that StarHub is the most realistic merger partner for M1 as the telco companies prepare for a 2027 consolidation.
aiSummaryBullets: Keppel chief executive Loh Chin Hua identified StarHub as the most viable partner for a merger with M1.
The proposed merger is expected to reach completion by mid-2027, with no changes planned for mobile plan pricing until that time.
The corporate restructuring includes a separate agreement for StarHub to acquire the mobile virtual network operator Circles.Life.
aiContextParagraph: The telecommunications sector in Singapore is undergoing a significant transition following the announcement of a proposed merger between StarHub and M1. Loh Chin Hua, the chief executive of M1's parent company Keppel, recently articulated the strategic rationale for the deal, describing StarHub as the only realistic partner for the merger. He noted that the consolidation is intended to help the combined entity conserve capital, which will support future business integration and growth initiatives. While the merger is slated for completion in 2027, industry analysts have raised questions regarding potential long-term pressure on profit margins and pricing structures. Additionally, the broader restructuring plan incorporates a separate acquisition of the mobile virtual network operator Circles.Life by StarHub. As the transition moves toward its mid-2027 completion date, mobile subscribers have been advised that current plan pricing will remain stable.
whyItIsViral: The merger has attracted attention from two independent outlets and maintains strong search interest, driven by the involvement of major corporate entities.
